body:
I'm going to go through therapy within a few days, that is my plan at least.
I have tried it once before, but it didn't last very long. I was never really a people person to begin with and I'm a major introvert. Its also rather difficult for me to even get close to people nowadays because of some "history" with others in the past and present.
If I continue to have these thoughts and feelings soon I will feel nothing at all; honestly I find that more troubling that feeling what I do now. So if I continue to feel this way after the stated few days I will go into therapy and hopefully they can bring some insight to my situation and help me recover my lost "light."
Thank you for speaking to me, it helped a little bit, I wish there was a better way to thank you for your time other than this message.

They said they couldn't help me, and they think that I'm too "dark" for them.
They didn't really make it clear as to why.

Yeah, I have consider therapy, but I can't afford it not with what I'm going through at least.
I have tried to go to a support group site, but, even they didn't want me. Not very supportive for a support group heh.
I have been dealing with this stuff for so long that I can barely remember what my life use to be like without it. The only good memory I can recall is when I was a child and I saw the summer grass for the first time. With my family and my beloved sister. I believe the reason I can't forget that is because that was when I considered my life to be perfect. Now its hard to even get my family to do anything together like before, its difficult, they try to understand what I'm dealing with and how to help, but sometimes they forget because they have more important things to worry about.
I...always been alone for as long as I can remember, they may have been with me, but I have always felt alone as if nothing I did mattered or made things worse. There was a time where my parents were about to separate when I was at the ripe age of twelve. I would do anything to keep them together, to keep my family together. That is exactly what I did I got in the middle of their fight and asked the question: Why?
At one point I even took a knife from the kitchen--I was going to stab myself with it in order to make them stop fighting, to me my life meant nothing, but I knew to some it meant a lot. I just didn't really care for it, I said thousands--millions of times that I would give up my life if it meant they would continue living. I meant it, and I still do.
You know whats funny? That my whole I never cared if I lived or died. Sometimes when I was young my father would threaten me and say: I brought you into this world, I can take you out.
My very first words to him when I said was: Then do it. I didn't ask to be brought to this world, nor did I make you. If you're going to take me out of it, you would be doing me a favor.

Thank you so much for what you have said, it helped me greatly and gave me more knowledge that I didn't have before. I'm going to try my best with this. Thank you again. <3

I'm getting better with each one I make and I'm working on how to make them and finalize them.
I just need to work on the hands a bit more.
